title: Roofing – Waterproofing (Hotmelt / Radmat)
activity: Hotmelt/Foamglas and torch-on warm roofs: prep, VCL, insulation, membranes, leak test
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Deck clean, dry, free from dust/laitance; outlets in and open?
Peel test done for adhesion to the concrete?
Primer fully covering, dried at least 24 hours, no rain or frost forecast?
Quality benchmark agreed for this area?
Ask the fitter: What laps are you working to, and when is the leak test? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: VCL fully adhered, no air bubbles; laps sealed?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – VCL; ITP 00006 2.3

questions.q: Upstands at least 150 mm above finished surface, top edge into a chase ≥10 mm deep (or flashed), outlets and penetrations fully detailed?
Insulation the right board, laid black face up, broken bond, no gaps (Foamglas fully bonded where used)?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – insulation; ITP 00001 2.3

questions.q: Insulation adhesive beads at 300 mm centres (150 mm at perimeter)?
Underlay and cap sheet laps: side at least 80 mm, end at least 100 mm (150 mm where the LPL detail says)?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – Eshaflex laps

questions.q: Upstands at least 150 mm above finished surface, outlets and penetrations fully detailed?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – upstand board; ITP 00006 2.5

questions.q: Electronic leak/integrity test passed before flagging or covering?
Membrane protected from following trades, no damage?

notOk.t: Water ponding – falls not to outlets / outlets set high
Membrane damaged by scaffold / stillages with no protection
Gaps at corner pieces; membrane peeling
Trapped water / bubbles in the system
Bleeding of membrane at edges / hotmelt over adjacent works

ask.q: What laps on the underlay and cap sheet?
ask.a: Side at least 80 mm, end at least 100 mm (150 mm where the detail says).
At least 150 mm above the finished surface.

ask.q: How is the top edge finished where there's no flashing?
ask.a: Into a chase at least 10 mm deep (EPR 27).
